scenario_en: A legacy project has 62% coverage and no settled path to 80%. A teaching gate can first require no decline under the same measurement contract while tracking absolute improvement separately.
scenario_zh: 遗留项目当前测试覆盖为62%，团队尚未决定如何达到80%。教学门槛可先要求同一测量契约下不低于62%，让新增退化可识别，同时把绝对改进另列工作。

name_zh: 区分不同类型的测量证据
summary_en: Separate static potential-impact findings from lab, field and trace measurements.
summary_zh: 分别标明静态分析、实验室测试、真实用户数据和执行记录。
scenario_en: A performance review has source code and one lab report. The teaching report gives LCP=2.8 seconds under stated device/network conditions, with no real-user data. Source reveals an unsized hero image. These do not establish a field p75.
scenario_zh: 审查网页性能时只有源码与一份实验室报告。教学报告在指定设备/网络条件下给出LCP=2.8秒，没有真实用户数据；源码发现首屏大图未设尺寸。不能把这些材料组合成虚构的用户p75。

name_zh: 排除正常波动后再判断改进
summary_en: Compare one change under equivalent measurement conditions and require signal beyond normal variance.
summary_zh: 在相同条件下比较单个变化，只有差异超过正常波动才认为有效。
scenario_en: A parser changes from one 100 ms run to 97 ms while ordinary runs span 95–105 ms. The teaching difference lies within variation, not established improvement.
scenario_zh: 解析器优化从一次100毫秒变为97毫秒，但平常运行在95–105毫秒之间。教学差异落在波动内，不能据此宣布性能提高。

name_zh: 反向路由测试也要去往正确 Skill
summary_en: A negative routing example must route to its intended owner, not merely avoid one wrong skill.
summary_zh: 测试“不该调用这个 Skill”时，还要确认请求被交给合适的替代者。
scenario_en: Test whether “write a regression test” incorrectly routes to code-review rather than test-driven-development. Review scoring 0 while every skill also scores 0 does not establish correct ownership.
scenario_zh: 测试“写一个回归测试”是否误触评审Skill。教学候选为code-review和test-driven-development；评审得0且所有候选都0，不能证明请求被正确路由。

name_zh: 避免重复设置路由层
summary_en: Avoid stacking a full meta-router on top of a host that already selects the same skills natively.
summary_zh: 宿主已经能选择相同的 Skill 时，不再常驻一套完整的额外路由指令。
scenario_en: Configure a host with skill-description discovery while considering an always-loaded lifecycle router. Teaching host H has inspectable records selecting review for review requests and implement for feature requests. The extra router covers the same tasks. Verify effective discovery before retaining a second layer.
scenario_zh: 你在配置一个能发现 Skill 描述的宿主，还准备把完整的任务路由器放进常驻提示词。教学宿主 H 已有可核对记录：审查请求选择 review，功能实现请求选择 implement；额外路由器也处理同一组任务。先验证真实发现能力，再决定是否保留第二层。

name_en: Protected content through an editable projection
name_zh: 通过引用编辑受保护内容
summary_en: Keep protected content in an authoritative store while the editing view contains explicit opaque references.
summary_zh: 受保护正文保存在权威库中，编辑视图只保留明确的引用。
scenario_en: Refactor your own code in a file while preserving a vendor block byte for byte. The teaching task only permits renaming an outside variable. Keep the working file runnable; a separate editing projection may reference [[VENDOR_BLOCK_1]], but that projection is not compilable source.
scenario_zh: 你要重构一个文件中自己的代码，供应商代码块必须保持原字节。教学任务只允许改块外变量名。工作文件要继续可运行；编辑视图可以用 [[VENDOR_BLOCK_1]] 引用保护块，但不能把这个视图当可编译源码。

name_zh: 先确定要回答的问题，再设置监控
summary_en: Choose instrumentation from the questions an operator must answer.
summary_zh: 根据操作人员需要判断什么，选择要记录的指标和信号。
scenario_en: Operators need failed runs, latency locations and duplicate retries for an import. Teaching fields are run_id/stage/error class/duration; full payloads may be private. Logging everything can cost more without answering those questions.
scenario_zh: 后台导入出错，操作人员要知道哪些运行失败、耗时在哪、重试是否重复。教学已有run_id、阶段、错误类别和时长，完整载荷可能含私人数据。没有问题驱动地记录全部内容会增加成本却仍答不出问题。

name_zh: 先核实评审意见，再安排修复
summary_en: Treat reviewer output as hypotheses and classify against the actual artifact before acting.
summary_zh: 把评审结论当作待验证的判断，结合实际产物分类后再行动。
scenario_en: A cache allows up to 30 seconds of staleness. Review says any stale data is wrong, while another path really permits unbounded staleness. Neither fixing nor dismissing both wholesale is appropriate.
scenario_zh: 缓存契约允许最多30秒陈旧，评审却说任何陈旧都错误；另一路径确实可能无限陈旧。不能把两条意见一并修掉或一并忽略。

name_en: Pass review artifacts through inert input channels
name_zh: 用不会执行内容的方式传递评审材料
summary_en: Preserve artifact text as data when invoking an external reviewer.
summary_zh: 调用外部评审工具时，让待审文本始终作为数据传入。
scenario_en: An authorized external review reads code with quotes, backticks and command-substitution syntax. Shell interpolation can execute the artifact before it reaches the reviewer as data.
scenario_zh: 授权的外部评审需要读取含反引号、引号和命令替换语法的代码。把材料插进shell字符串可能在调用评审器前就执行它，而不是作为待审文本传入。

name_zh: 分别检查任务完成和项目就绪
summary_en: Require the requested behavior and the standing project readiness bar separately.
summary_zh: 既验证本次要求的行为，也检查项目一贯的交付要求。
scenario_en: Add a CSV export button. Task acceptance requires the two currently filtered rows; standing project requirements also cover keyboard use, errors and build checks. One download does not satisfy both sets.
scenario_zh: 给页面添加CSV导出按钮。本次验收要求导出当前筛选的两行，而项目常设要求还包括键盘可用、错误状态和构建检查；下载一次不代表两个集合都满足。

name_en: Reuse verification until its assumptions change
name_zh: 条件没变化时复用验证结果
summary_en: Repeat a successful check only when relevant code or baseline assumptions have changed.
summary_zh: 只有相关代码或基线假设变化后，才重跑已经通过的检查。
scenario_en: Parser tests passed for current code, fixtures and locked dependencies, then README wording changed. Retain parser evidence while checking documentation; executable examples may affect a different scope.
scenario_zh: 解析器测试已在当前实现、夹具和锁定依赖上通过，随后只修改README措辞。可以保留解析器证据，同时验证文档；若改README中的可执行示例则影响范围可能不同。

name_zh: 验证监控通道本身能工作
summary_en: Check the telemetry path by generating a known signal and finding it through the intended channel.
summary_zh: 主动生成已知信号，确认能从预期的通道查到它。
scenario_en: After adding import-failure logs/alerts, verify collection, aggregation, lookup and test notification. Teaching test-r9 creates a controlled failure in isolation; logger code alone does not establish a working chain.
scenario_zh: 新增导入失败日志和报警后，要证明记录能经过采集、聚合、查询与测试通知通道。教学请求test-r9在隔离环境产生可控失败；日志代码存在不证明这条链已工作。

name_en: Use a deadline independent of stream activity
name_zh: 为流式任务设置总时限
summary_en: Use a total operation deadline as well as inactivity detection so keepalives cannot occupy a worker indefinitely.
summary_zh: 除无活动超时外，还设置总截止时间，避免心跳让任务无限占用资源。
scenario_en: A stream emits keepalives without completion. Teaching case starts UTC10:00 with absolute 10:02 deadline plus separate inactivity timer. Resetting the only timeout permits indefinite occupancy.
scenario_zh: 流式评估一直发心跳，但没有最终结果。教学案例开始UTC10:00，总截止10:02；无活动超时另计。每次心跳重置唯一计时器会让任务无限占槽，需要独立总期限。

name_en: Keep answer keys outside agent reach
name_zh: 不让被测 Agent 接触标准答案
summary_en: Make evaluation answers structurally unavailable to the system being tested, including history and earlier-trial artifacts.
summary_zh: 把答案与被测系统隔离，包括历史记录和前几轮生成的文件。
scenario_en: Evaluate diagnosis of a fixture whose symptom is “the list stays stale after saving.” The grader knows the cause, but a reachable gold.json or history lets the system obtain it directly.
scenario_zh: 评估Agent能否诊断样本仓库故障，症状是“保存后列表仍旧”。评分器知道原因，但gold.json若在工作树或历史里，被测系统可直接取答案。

name_en: Keep attempts, grades and traces coherent
name_zh: 把评分和记录绑定到同一次尝试
summary_en: Distinguish a scorable result from an attempt failure and keep each result’s grade, trace and usage bound to the same invocation.
summary_zh: 区分执行失败与可评分结果，确保分数、轨迹和用量属于同一次调用。
scenario_en: Attempt a1 for case-c1 repetition 1 times out; after recovery a2 returns a scorable answer. Treating a1 as a negative result blocks resume, while pairing a2’s grade with a1’s trace mixes evidence.
scenario_zh: 评估case-c1的第1次重复时调用a1超时；恢复后a2得到可评分答案。若把a1当“否定答案”写进结果槽，续跑会跳过；若a2评分配a1轨迹，又会拼错证据。

name_en: Separate build variance from scoring variance
name_zh: 区分生成波动与评分波动
summary_en: When a prompt builds an artifact that is later evaluated, measure build variability separately from repeated scoring of one artifact.
summary_zh: 分别测量每次生成产物的差异，以及对同一产物重复评分的差异。
scenario_en: A prompt builds a retrieval index that queries later score. Stable repeated scores for one index do not establish stable generation; randomness occurs at both build and scoring levels.
scenario_zh: 提示先生成检索索引，再用查询评分。同一个索引重复评分结果很稳定，不能因此认定索引生成本身稳定；随机性在构建与评分两个层级。

name_zh: 保留完整的响应结构
summary_en: Retain structured response state for continuation and derive human-readable text as a separate view.
summary_zh: 续接任务时使用完整的结构化响应，把可读文本作为单独视图。
scenario_en: An agent response contains text, a tool call and opaque continuation state. You need both display and tool-loop continuation. The teaching envelope has text 'Checking', tool_call id=call-7 and opaque content. Its host requires necessary blocks/order on continuation and a result referencing call-7. These are illustrative fields, not a complete SDK schema.
scenario_zh: 一个 Agent 响应含文字、工具调用和不透明续接状态，你既要显示回答，也要继续工具流程。教学信封有 text“正在检查”、tool_call 的 id=call-7，以及 opaque 内容；宿主约定续接时保留必要块与顺序，并让工具结果引用 call-7。字段仅是教学示意，不是某个 SDK 的完整 schema。

name_zh: 根据具体结论提出核验问题
summary_en: Attach optional verification questions to actual claims and assumptions, and omit them when the user already requested that verification.
summary_zh: 问题应对应真实的结论和假设；用户已经要求核验时直接执行。
scenario_en: An expansion plan assumes 20% conversion without local evidence. Verification questions should target this decision-driving assumption; when verification is requested, perform authorized checks first.
scenario_zh: 扩张计划用20%转化率估算结果，但用户没有提供本地数据。核验问题要对应这个决定所依赖的数字；若用户已要求查证，就应先做授权范围内的核验。

name_en: Retain full validation beside a compatible schema
name_zh: 简化 schema 时保留完整业务校验
summary_en: Keep the full business validation contract when a host accepts only a reduced schema representation.
summary_zh: 宿主只接受部分 schema 特性时，仍要在其他位置执行完整校验。
scenario_en: A host accepts numeric shapes but not teaching price>=0/positive-integer qty. The wire projection provides types only; strict labels do not enforce removed business constraints.
scenario_zh: 结构化输出宿主接受数字类型但不执行本题价格非负约束。教学完整契约price>=0、qty为正整数；传输投影只支持类型。strict标签不意味着被删掉的业务约束已经验证。

name_en: Preserve coordinate units through tool handoffs
name_zh: 工具交接时保留坐标单位
summary_en: Carry units, dimensions and origin with positions; normalize mixed coordinate sources before a downstream operation.
summary_zh: 位置数据同时传递单位、尺寸和原点；混用不同坐标来源时先转换。
scenario_en: A PDF form combines an address rectangle extracted in points with a signature rectangle detected in pixels. The teaching input is a 600×800-point page and its 1200×1600-pixel full-page image; the signature rectangle is (200,400,600,600), measured from the upper left. Merging the numbers directly misplaces the signature.
scenario_zh: 填写一份 PDF 时，结构提取给出的地址框用点表示，截图识别出的签名框用像素表示。教学输入是一页 600×800 点的文档及对应的 1200×1600 像素整页图片；签名框为左上原点矩形 (200,400,600,600)。直接合并四个数字会把签名放到错误位置。

name_en: Regrade all variants after a criterion change
name_zh: 评分规则变化后重新评估所有方案
summary_en: When a metric or grader changes, apply it consistently to stored outputs from every compared variant before recommending a winner.
summary_zh: 用新指标对所有候选的已保存输出重新评分，再推荐最佳方案。
scenario_en: A report benchmark graded structure but omitted factual fidelity. Teaching baseline B and candidate C have saved outputs. Under the new criterion, compare regraded results for both, not C’s new score against B’s old score.
scenario_zh: 报告生成评估原来只评分结构，后来发现缺少事实准确性。教学基线B与候选C都有保存输出；新标准只能比较双方重评分结果，不能将C新分数与B旧分数相减。

name_zh: 区分 Agent 定义版本与运行实例
summary_en: Reuse a versioned agent definition while giving each execution its own run identity.
summary_zh: 复用有版本的定义，但每次执行使用独立的运行 ID。
scenario_en: Two jobs reuse reviewed configuration. The teaching host supports immutable agent-a v3 and distinct run IDs with explicit version references. Latest-only or untracked per-job definitions obscure what actually ran.
scenario_zh: 服务要用同一套已审 Agent 配置运行两个作业。教学宿主确实支持不可变定义版本：agent-a v3；每次执行有独立 run id，运行可指定版本。使用 latest 或每次重建无记录定义，会让事后无法说明实际配置。

name_en: Move deterministic loop steps into code
name_zh: 确定性的步骤交给普通代码
summary_en: Use ordinary code for steps fully determined by their inputs and retain model judgment for the ambiguous remainder.
summary_zh: 输入已完全决定结果的步骤用代码处理，只让模型判断有歧义的部分。
scenario_en: An agent repeatedly normalizes invoice currencies/totals and interprets unclear descriptions. Teaching I1=usd/100 cents, I2=USD/250 and I3=EUR/300; allowed currencies are USD/EUR with separate sums and no exchange. I2 service/I3 fee classification needs contract context.
scenario_zh: Agent 重复处理发票行，既做固定币种归一和求和，也解释不清楚的描述。教学行 I1=usd/100 分、I2=USD/250 分、I3=EUR/300 分；规则只允许 USD/EUR，按币种分别求和，不做换汇。I2 的 service、I3 的 fee 分类还需要合同背景。

name_en: Use fresh no-change controls after drift
name_zh: 条件变化后重新设置无改动对照
summary_en: When execution conditions change, compare a candidate against a contemporaneous unchanged control rather than only an old baseline number.
summary_zh: 环境变化时，用同一时期的原方案作对照，避免只与历史分数比较。
scenario_en: A candidate scores 0.8 this week against last week’s0.7 baseline after serving conditions changed. Rerun the unchanged prompt now to distinguish drift from intervention.
scenario_zh: 候选提示本周得0.8，上周旧提示得0.7，但服务环境已变。需要在当前条件重跑未改旧提示，才能判断差异是不是环境漂移。

name_en: Grade the environment left by an agent
name_zh: 检查 Agent 操作后的实际环境
summary_en: For an agent that changes an environment, score the resulting state and use transcripts for explicit process constraints.
summary_zh: 任务会改变环境时，应评分最终状态；对话记录用于检查过程要求。
scenario_en: A coding agent claims the counter race is fixed. The teaching environment allows counter.ts changes but not test expectations. Final state/behavior, not a polished summary, establishes the result.
scenario_zh: 代码修复Agent称计数器竞争已解决。教学环境允许改counter.ts但不允许改测试期望；最终状态与行为才能证明结果，漂亮总结不能代替工作树。

name_zh: 多轮比较使用同一组参考产物
summary_en: Compare iterative candidates with the same saved reference artifacts and retain older references when adding a harder comparison.
summary_zh: 保留固定参考文件；增加更难的对照时也保留旧参考。
scenario_en: Iterate a report prompt using per-case blind win rates. Regenerating opponents each round changes what v1/v2 face. Teaching reference R0 should be saved once and fixed.
scenario_zh: 多轮改写报告提示，用逐例盲比评胜率。若每轮重新生成对手，v1与v2比较的对象就不同；教学参考R0应保存一次并固定。

name_zh: 断线重连时补齐遗漏事件
summary_en: Recover a dropped event stream by overlapping live delivery with history and deduplicating by event ID while checking stop conditions independently.
summary_zh: 结合实时流和历史记录恢复事件，按事件 ID 去重，并独立检查停止条件。
scenario_en: After a task stream disconnects, the interface must recover missed messages without updating an order twice. Teaching history contains e1=start and e2=complete; the replacement stream also delivers e2=complete. IDs are stable and history is paginated. The repeated completion event must still stop the consumer.
scenario_zh: 任务事件流断线后，界面需要补回遗漏消息且不能重复更新订单。教学历史返回 e1=开始、e2=完成，新流也返回 e2=完成；事件 ID 稳定，历史可分页查询。重复的完成事件仍须让消费者停止。

name_en: Record the origin of evaluation references
name_zh: 说明评测参考答案的来源
summary_en: Record whether reference answers are independently verified or generated by a system under comparison.
summary_zh: 标明答案是独立核验的，还是由参与比较的系统生成的。
scenario_en: When comparing summarizers, the answer key comes from the incumbent. Teaching source says unknown cause, while its summary invents database failure. Exact matching would reward the error.
scenario_zh: 比较新旧摘要器时，答案键来自旧系统输出。教学原文只有“原因未知”，旧摘要却写“数据库故障”；精确匹配旧文本会把错误模仿当正确。

name_en: Keep selection feedback out of revision prompts
name_zh: 修订提示词时隔离保留样本的反馈
summary_en: Keep withheld-case results out of the prompt that proposes revisions, and name the resulting selection set accurately.
summary_zh: 不把保留样本的结果透露给改写提示词的模型，并准确描述筛选样本的用途。
scenario_en: A routing description is revised from training failures and reserved queries select winners each round. Even if the reviser never reads queries, repeated selection makes them validation/selection, not an independent final test.
scenario_zh: 路由描述按训练失败改写，保留查询用于每轮选赢家。即使修订模型没有读这些查询，只要其分数用于反复选择，这组仍是验证/选择集而非最终独立测试。

name_en: Classify text by its control function
name_zh: 按作用区分指令文本
summary_en: Evaluate instruction text according to whether it defines a tool contract, routes a task or directs loaded behavior.
summary_zh: 分别评估工具接口说明、任务路由规则和实际行为指令。
scenario_en: Use this appears in skill metadata, tool schemas and loaded bodies, serving routing, contracts or behavior. Keyword blacklists cannot classify them.
scenario_zh: 审提示时“Use this”同时出现在Skill描述、工具schema说明和加载正文。相同短语可能分别负责路由、接口契约和行为，不能用关键词黑名单全删。

name_zh: 按用户意图推荐当前可用资料
summary_en: Recommend a concrete resource only when the user wants learning material and a current catalog supports it.
summary_zh: 用户需要学习资料时，才依据最新目录推荐具体资源。
scenario_en: A user explicitly wants short beginner material for analysts, and a readable current catalog is available. The teaching item Analyst Basics has URL https://learn.example.test/analyst-basics, requires sign-in and is before staleAfter. Item and domain are fictional fixtures, not real course recommendations.
scenario_zh: 用户明确想找面向分析师的简短入门资料，你有当前可读目录。教学条目“分析师基础”的 URL 为 https://learn.example.test/analyst-basics，标记需要登录，目录 staleAfter 尚未到期。域名和条目为虚构教学材料，不能当真实课程推荐。

name_en: Confirm the selected configuration as a whole
name_zh: 确认最终组合配置能工作
summary_en: After selecting interacting settings in separate stages, evaluate the final combination on fresh runs against criteria fixed before confirmation.
summary_zh: 分步选择多个设置后，用新运行验证最终组合，并沿用预先确定的标准。
scenario_en: Model selection, prompt revision and lower reasoning each had favorable stages, but teaching M2+P3+E-low never ran jointly. The prompt may depend on richer reasoning.
scenario_zh: 先选模型、再改提示、最后降低推理设置，各阶段都有好结果。但教学组合M2+P3+E-low从未一起运行，提示可能依赖较高推理预算。

name_en: Classify the failing layer when optimization stalls
name_zh: 优化无效时先定位失败层
summary_en: When repeated edits fail to move an evaluation, classify remaining failures by the layer that could explain them before adding more instructions.
summary_zh: 连续改写没有改善结果时，先判断问题在哪一层，而非继续堆指令。
scenario_en: Repeated stronger use-search instructions leave retrieval scores flat. Teaching traces show search was never registered; more prompt text cannot fix missing harness tools. Wrong grading or variance may also explain failure.
scenario_zh: 连续加强“使用搜索”指令，检索评估仍不变。教学轨迹显示search未注册；再加提示不能修好宿主缺工具，也可能遇到错误评分或普通波动。

name_en: Evaluate the real application entry point
name_zh: 从真实应用入口进行评测
summary_en: Exercise the application path that assembles context, routes tools and handles retries, rather than recreating its final model request.
summary_zh: 走应用实际的上下文组装、工具路由和重试路径，而非只复刻最终请求。
scenario_en: Compare support prompts in an application that assembles customer context, retrieves, retries and routes tools. Copying the prompt into a direct model request evaluates a replacement path.
scenario_zh: 比较客服应用的两个提示版本，应用入口还会拼接客户上下文、检索、重试和调用工具。单独复制提示发给模型只测了绕过这些路径的替代程序。

name_en: Keep pruning assumptions and deferred choices
name_zh: 保留被排除选项及其理由
summary_en: Record the assumptions behind a search exclusion and retain the candidate so it can be reopened when evidence or prerequisites change.
summary_zh: 记录排除候选的假设，条件变化时可重新考虑。
scenario_en: Cost comparison deferred B using a profile from prompt v1 and another runtime setting. Prompt v2 may change token texture, while B has no current measurement. An unfavorable projection is not a permanent verdict.
scenario_zh: 你在比较配置 A/B 的成本，B 被来自旧提示 v1、不同运行设置的预测暂时排除。现在提示改成 v2，之前的输入/输出剖面可能不适用。教学没有对 B 当前版本实际测量，不能把预测不利当永久结论。

name_en: Check instruction scope before resolving conflicts
name_zh: 处理指令冲突前检查作用范围
summary_en: Compare the scope and load conditions of two instructions before treating different wording as a conflict.
summary_zh: 先比较两条指令的适用条件和加载时机，再判断是否真的冲突。
scenario_en: Maintain two agent guides. Teaching root guide R requires integration tests for code changes; docs guide D requires link checks for documentation-only edits. The current change touches docs text only. Different commands need scope analysis before deleting an older rule.
scenario_zh: 你在维护两份 Agent 指南。教学根指南 R 规定代码修改运行集成测试，docs 指南 D 规定仅改文档时运行链接检查；当前改动只涉及 docs 文本。看到不同命令，先判断它们是否作用于同一任务，不按提交先后直接删一条。

name_zh: 按稳定程度排列可缓存的上下文
summary_en: For a host with a verified prefix-cache contract, place stable inputs before volatile inputs and check the rendered overlapping prefix when reuse regresses.
summary_zh: 确认服务支持前缀缓存后，把稳定输入放前面；缓存异常时检查实际生成的前缀。
scenario_en: Repeated policy/document analysis runs on a host whose prefix-cache contract has been verified. Teaching request N is request_id=r1 → policy-v2 → document-a → question-1; N+1 begins with r2. A changing ID ahead of shared material may break reuse. This article discusses assembly/checks without paid API calls.
scenario_zh: 你在一个已核实支持前缀缓存的宿主上反复分析同一政策和文档。教学请求 N 为“request_id=r1 → policy-v2 → document-a → question-1”，N+1 开头变成 r2。动态 id 放在共享内容前，可能破坏可复用前缀；本篇只讨论组装和检查，不实际调用付费 API。

name_en: Validate the whole streamed turn before acting
name_zh: 完整校验流式响应后再执行工具
summary_en: Gate client-side tool execution on completed generation, strict input parsing and the tool’s validation contract.
summary_zh: 等生成结束、参数解析和工具校验都通过，再执行客户端工具。
scenario_en: A streaming assistant is about to write notes.txt. The teaching turn contains write_file call u1 with a plausible parsed path and contents, but ends at the output limit. Writing as soon as fields arrive could overwrite existing notes with incomplete content.
scenario_zh: 流式助手准备写入 notes.txt。教学轮次包含 write_file 调用 u1，解析对象看似有 path 与 contents，但最终停止原因为输出上限。若收到字段就写文件，截短内容可能覆盖已有笔记。

name_en: Promote opaque actions to typed control points
name_zh: 把需要管控的动作定义成明确工具
summary_en: Expose an action as a typed tool when the harness needs to gate, render, audit or schedule that action specifically.
summary_zh: 需要单独授权、显示、审计或调度的动作，应提供有类型约束的工具接口。
scenario_en: An invoice assistant can use a general shell, but invoice delivery must display the exact invoice and recipient first. The teaching task sends INV-17 to billing@example.test; the host has an approval policy for that pair. It needs to recognize the sending action to apply the policy.
scenario_zh: 发票助手能调用通用 Shell，但发送发票前必须展示确切发票与收件人。教学任务是把 INV-17 发给 billing@example.test；宿主已有针对该组合的审批规则。需要明确识别发送动作才能应用这条规则。

name_en: Trace invalid data back to its origin
name_zh: 沿调用路径查找错误数据的起点
summary_en: Walk backward from a failing effect through callers and values to identify where the bad input originated.
summary_zh: 从失败结果向上追踪调用者和参数，定位错误输入最早产生的位置。
scenario_en: A workspace operation runs in the wrong directory. Teaching exec receives an empty projectDir, possibly read from tempDir before initialization. The downstream symptom does not justify swallowing command errors.
scenario_zh: 工作区操作在错误目录执行，教学exec收到projectDir空字符串。症状出现在下游命令，但空值可能来自初始化前读取的tempDir，不能只在命令处吞错。

name_en: Prove behavioral RED before minimal GREEN
name_zh: 先确认测试因缺少目标行为而失败
summary_en: Verify that a behavioral test fails for the intended missing behavior before implementing the smallest change that passes it.
summary_zh: 先验证测试能抓到真正的问题，再实现最小改动使其通过。
scenario_en: A form accepts empty email but must reject with required while valid input saves. Teaching submitEmail expects empty saved=false/error=required and valid saved=true. Prove the test detects missing behavior before implementing rather than mirroring current code afterward.
scenario_zh: 表单接受空邮箱，目标是拒绝并显示 required 错误，合法地址仍可保存。教学函数 submitEmail 的目标返回空输入 saved=false、error=required，正常地址 saved=true。测试需要先证明能抓到缺失行为，不是先修代码再围绕它写一个会过的断言。

name_zh: 汇总前区分增量与累计计数
summary_en: Determine whether metrics are increments or cumulative observations before aggregating them.
summary_zh: 先确认指标是本次增量还是累计读数，避免重复计入总数。
scenario_en: One session’s cumulative token observations are 100,140,200. Usage between first and last is not their sum 440. A separate per-call total task has different boundaries.
scenario_zh: 同一会话累计token读数为100、140、200，要算第一次到最后一次之间用量。相加得到440重复计入历史；另一个统计任务可能要每个调用最终累计总量，边界不同。

name_zh: 按任务风险决定指令精度
summary_en: Choose broad guidance, parameterized recipes or exact commands according to the task’s justified variation and failure cost.
summary_zh: 根据可接受的变化和失败代价，选择宽泛建议、参数化步骤或精确命令。
scenario_en: Instructions serve flexible review and fragile migration. Multiple review paths can work while migration needs a verified sequence; freedom should match variability/consequence.
scenario_zh: 同一套说明要服务开放式评审和脆弱迁移。评审有多个合理路径，迁移只有已验证序列；指令自由度应对应操作变异与后果。

name_en: Wait on a fresh observable predicate
name_zh: 等待明确的就绪条件
summary_en: Replace guessed delays with a fresh readiness predicate and a bounded timeout.
summary_zh: 用刚读取的可观察条件判断是否就绪，并设置超时，避免猜测等待时间。
scenario_en: An export takes different amounts of time under load, and a test needs job-7's result. A teaching getter initially returns pending, then ready with a result path. A fixed 50 ms delay does not establish completion.
scenario_zh: 导出任务在不同负载下耗时不同，测试需要读取 job-7 的结果。教学 getter 初始返回 pending，随后返回 ready 与结果路径；等待固定50毫秒不能证明该任务完成。

name_zh: 用独立且能发现错误的标准验证
summary_en: Derive expected values independently and check that plausible wrong behavior would fail the test.
summary_zh: 独立计算预期值，并确认看似合理的错误行为也会导致测试失败。
scenario_en: Test serialization of the urgent search filter. If expected and actual both use buildSearchQuery, the same missing-field defect can repeat on both sides and equality stays green.
scenario_zh: 测试搜索过滤器urgent的序列化。若expected与actual都调用buildSearchQuery，同一个丢字段错误会在两边重复，等式仍通过。

name_zh: 关键行动前说明不确定的假设
summary_en: Make uncertain requirements and competing interpretations explicit before an irreversible choice.
summary_zh: 不可逆选择之前，明确有歧义的要求和不同解释。
scenario_en: An export request lacks audience, fields and destination. The teaching interface supports id/email/phone and local/shared targets; capability is not selection. Publishing sensitive full data creates consequences a revised prompt cannot recall.
scenario_zh: 用户请求导出，但受众、字段和位置未明确。教学接口能导 id、email、phone，也能写本地或共享位置；能力列表不是用户选择。全量敏感字段加公开位置一旦执行，会产生不能靠改提示词撤回的影响。

name_zh: 只实现当前需要的复杂度
summary_en: Defer speculative features and abstractions until a concrete requirement justifies them.
summary_zh: 有具体需求后再增加功能和抽象，避免为想象中的未来提前设计。
scenario_en: An existing service needs one percentage-discount function, with no other discount mode requested. The teaching contract uses nonnegative integer cents and an integer percentage from 0 to 100; calculate floor(amount * (100 - percent) / 100) and reject invalid inputs. An integer-validation utility already exists.
scenario_zh: 现有服务需要一个百分比折扣函数，没有其他折扣模式的需求。教学约定：金额使用非负整数分，百分比是 0–100 的整数；折后金额按 floor(amount * (100 - percent) / 100) 计算，不符合输入约定时报错。现有代码已有整数校验工具。

name_zh: 把模糊任务改成可验证目标
summary_en: Translate vague actions into observable success criteria and verify each meaningful step.
summary_zh: 说明成功时能观察到什么，并在每个关键步骤核验。
scenario_en: Fix old sessions remaining active after password change. The teaching app requires the same account's old session rejected while new login works: old access 200→401, new access 200. Check this contract rather than vaguely improving auth.
scenario_zh: 用户要求修复改密码后旧会话仍有效的问题。教学应用契约规定：同一账号旧会话在密码修改后应被拒绝，新登录仍能访问；旧会话访问状态原为 200，目标为 401。目标必须按该契约检查，不能泛泛说“改善认证”。

name_zh: 让每项修改都对应用户请求
summary_en: Bound authorized edits to the requested behavior and only clean up orphans created by those edits.
summary_zh: 只改已授权的行为，并仅清理这些改动产生的无用内容。
scenario_en: Repair empty-email validation in a file with unrelated username rules and old unused functions. Every teaching edit should trace to the request, not incidental policy/reformatting.
scenario_zh: 获准修复验证器空邮箱路径，同文件还有用户名规则和历史未用函数。教学补丁应能解释每条变更与请求的关系，不能顺手改策略或全文格式。

name_zh: 区分官方实现与近似复刻
summary_en: Distinguish an official implementation from an inspired approximation.
summary_zh: 明确标注哪些来自官方，哪些只是受启发的近似实现。
scenario_en: A web card needs a look inspired by a native translucent material. The teaching implementation uses custom CSS blur, borders and highlights, with no official platform package. Similar appearance does not make the code official.
scenario_zh: 网页要做受原生半透明材料启发的卡片。教学实现是项目自写的CSS模糊、边框与高光，并未使用平台官方包。外观相似不能把代码称为官方实现。

name_zh: 保持统一身份，调整具体构图
summary_en: Keep shared identity fixed while varying individual artifact purpose and composition.
summary_zh: 系列产物保留共同标识，同时根据用途调整内容安排。
scenario_en: Create checkout, receipt and order-detail mockups that share product identity but serve different tasks. Teaching invariants are #1D4ED8, 16px body text, 6px corners and Cart/Orders/Profile navigation. Checkout emphasizes input, receipt a success summary and details order information.
scenario_zh: 你要制作结账、收据和订单详情三个界面草图，既要像同一产品，也要体现不同任务。教学共同规则：品牌色 #1D4ED8、正文 16px、圆角 6px、底部导航“购物车/订单/我的”；结账突出输入，收据突出成功摘要，详情突出订单信息。

name_zh: 根据任务决定规则优先级
summary_en: Gate aesthetic defaults by the task context and preserve explicit brand or user constraints.
summary_zh: 视觉默认规则应服从具体任务、品牌要求和用户的明确约束。
scenario_en: Improve an existing brand site. Its brief explicitly preserves purple #6D28D9 and asks for clearer hierarchy and spacing. A design reference discourages purple effects as a default. This does not require replacing an established brand color.
scenario_zh: 你要改进一个已有品牌站。简报明确要求保留品牌紫色 #6D28D9，改善内容层级和间距；设计参考文件则把紫色效果列为不推荐的默认选择。两者并不要求换掉现有品牌。

name_en: Successor screens require an action and carried state
name_zh: 页面之间要有动作和状态衔接
summary_en: Validate a visual sequence as a causal user journey, not just a screen count.
summary_zh: 把多屏设计当作完整用户旅程，检查触发下一屏的动作与传递的数据。
scenario_en: Storyboard cart→checkout→receipt with teaching sku-A×2 totaling 30. Attractive screens with changed products/amounts do not represent one journey.
scenario_zh: 设计购物车→结算→收据三屏教学流程：购物车商品sku-A两件，总额30。漂亮的独立屏幕若商品或金额改变，就无法表达同一旅程。

name_zh: 给看似真实的样例数据标明来源
summary_en: Require a source or visible mock status for factual-looking metrics and specifications.
summary_zh: 精确的指标和规格应有来源；模拟数据要明确标注。
scenario_en: An analytics prototype shows 47.2% growth as fictional composition data. Precision creates factual impressions, so provenance/mock status must accompany the metric visibly.
scenario_zh: 分析首页原型显示增长47.2%，这个数字是构图样例，并非来自真实业务。精确小数会给观众事实印象，来源或mock状态需要与指标一起可见。

name_zh: 先说明效果的用途，再添加效果
summary_en: Add an effect only after naming its communicative job.
summary_zh: 添加动画或视觉效果前，说明它要向用户传达什么。
scenario_en: Saving an item moves it to the top of a favorites list. You are considering motion to show where it went, instead of animating everything because a library is available. Success, failure and reduced-motion states all need meaningful feedback.
scenario_zh: 一个收藏列表在保存条目后把它移到顶部。你考虑加入动画，让用户知道条目去了哪里，而不是让所有组件因为有动画库就持续运动。已有保存成功、保存失败和减少动画三个状态需要表达。

name_en: Match reference granularity to inspection needs
name_zh: 按检查需求拆分参考资料
summary_en: Break dense references into units that preserve the details needed downstream.
summary_zh: 把密集参考拆成合适的单元，同时保留后续检查需要的细节。
scenario_en: Hand eight webpage sections from a long reference image to a coding agent: navigation, hero, features, examples, pricing, FAQ, action area and footer. A tiny collage obscures text/buttons. Provide inspectable references rather than generating a similar design to replace original evidence.
scenario_zh: 你要把网页的八个章节交给编码者，已有长参考图。教学清单是导航、主视觉、功能、示例、价格、FAQ、行动入口、页脚；把它们缩成一张小拼贴会让文字和按钮尺寸无法判断。目标是提供足够清晰的参考，不重新生成一份看似相同的设计替代原证据。

name_zh: 改版前盘点必须保留的行为
summary_en: Classify redesign intent and inventory nonvisual contracts before changing presentation.
summary_zh: 先明确改版目的，并检查路由、状态和交互等非视觉要求。
scenario_en: Improve spacing/type on a working checkout without a requested flow change. Teaching contracts include /checkout, email, checkout_submit and focus on the first invalid field. Layout changes can accidentally break these nonvisual relationships.
scenario_zh: 你要改善可用结算页的间距与字级，用户没有要求改变流程。教学现有契约包含 /checkout 路由、email 字段、checkout_submit 事件，以及错误时聚焦第一个无效字段。这些非视觉关系可能被一次重排意外破坏。

name_zh: 交接设计变量的名称、值和用途
summary_en: Express design tokens as semantic names, exact values and functional roles.
summary_zh: 用明确的语义名称、精确数值和功能角色描述设计 token。
scenario_en: Hand a palette to an implementer so pages preserve color roles. Teaching tokens are ink=#18181B for body text and action=#2563EB for primary buttons/focus indication. Missing name, value or purpose makes the recipient guess.
scenario_zh: 你要把调色板交给实现者，让多个页面使用相同颜色角色。教学 token 是正文主墨 ink=#18181B、行动蓝 action=#2563EB；action 用于主按钮和焦点标识，ink 用于正文。颜色名称、数值和用途缺一项，接手者都可能自行补猜。

name_en: Inspect the specimen before translating it
name_zh: 实现参考设计前先检查样本
summary_en: Extract an explicit visual contract before coding from a reference artifact.
summary_zh: 从参考文件中提取明确的视觉要求，再开始编码。
scenario_en: Implement a supplied landing-page reference. The teaching sample visibly says Clear task handoffs and View examples, with text left/comparison right, larger headline and generous space. It shows no hover/submission/mobile behavior. Inspect before reaching for a familiar card template.
scenario_zh: 你要实现给定着陆页参考，教学样本可读标题“清楚交接任务”、CTA“查看示例”，左侧文字右侧对照，正文比标题小且留白明显；图片没有悬停、提交或窄屏行为。先提取实际观察，不能看一眼就写熟悉卡片模板。

name_zh: 避免版式泄露测试答案
summary_en: Keep an assessment from leaking its answer through presentation differences.
summary_zh: 让不同选项的呈现方式保持一致，避免从布局看出正确答案。
scenario_en: Create a retry-policy quiz requiring waits and at most two retries for transient errors. A uniquely bold/long/detailed correct option lets learners answer from presentation.
scenario_zh: 编写重试策略测验：题设要求遇临时错误最多重试两次且等待，不能无限循环。正确选项若唯一加粗、最长或最详细，学习者可能靠版式答对。

name_zh: 主动验证保护规则能拦住违规
summary_en: Verify a guardrail rejects an intentional violation, then returns to clean success.
summary_zh: 构造一次故意违规的操作，确认被阻止，再恢复干净的成功状态。
scenario_en: A boundary rule forbids tests importing lib/impl and permits public entry points. Configuration presence does not prove lint:boundaries loads it; use allowed→violation→restored controls.
scenario_zh: 新规则禁止测试深导入lib/impl，只允许公开入口。配置文件存在不证明lint:boundaries真的加载这条规则；需要允许→违规→恢复的对照。

name_zh: 删除抽象层，推演复杂度会去哪
summary_en: Challenge an abstraction by predicting where complexity would go if it vanished.
summary_zh: 在保留一个抽象前，判断移除它后职责和复杂度会如何变化。
scenario_en: Decide whether to retain a parser wrapper with its implementation and two callers available. In teaching case A, readConfig only forwards to JSON.parse. In case B, it also validates required fields and sorts entries by ID, rules both callers need. Compare deletion consequences before editing code.
scenario_zh: 你在决定是否保留一个解析包装层，已有包装实现和两个调用点。教学情况 A 中 readConfig 只转发 JSON.parse；情况 B 中它还检查必要字段并把条目按 id 排序，两个调用者都依赖这些规则。先比较删除后的职责，不立即改代码。

name_zh: 用稳定的行为约定交接 Agent 任务
summary_en: Describe behavior and named interfaces instead of volatile file locations in delayed task handoffs.
summary_zh: 交接长期任务时说明行为和接口，避免依赖容易变化的文件位置。
scenario_en: Queue a CLI JSON-output fix for next week while files may be renamed. Teaching interface reportResult(result,options) serves a query command; success emits JSON but failure plain text. Under --json both must parse, retaining success exit 0 and failure exit 1.
scenario_zh: 你把 CLI 的 JSON 输出修复排到下周，文件可能在此期间改名。教学接口 reportResult(result, options) 服务于查询命令；当前成功时输出 JSON，失败时输出纯文本。要求 --json 下两种结果都可解析，同时保留成功退出码 0、失败退出码 1。

name_en: Environment as instruction source of truth
name_zh: 实时查询可执行的环境事实
summary_en: Avoid maintaining a stale prose cache of cheap executable environment facts.
summary_zh: 对便宜且可直接检查的环境信息，避免维护容易过期的文字副本。
scenario_en: A check script changed but several agent docs copied the old string. Cheap inspectable environment facts should come from current configuration; prose retains unwritten reasons.
scenario_zh: 项目check脚本已从旧命令换到新命令，但多份Agent文档复制旧字符串。能便宜读取的环境事实应从当前配置获得，文档保留找不到的原因与约定。

name_zh: 只把有证据的学习成果存入记忆
summary_en: Store demonstrated knowledge separately from material merely covered.
summary_zh: 区分已经证明掌握的知识和只是接触过的材料。
scenario_en: Choose the next lesson after explaining transaction isolation. The teaching learner viewed the lesson but demonstrated only one judgment: repeated reads may differ in a supplied schedule. Other anomalies are untested. Exposure, self-report and demonstrated use are different evidence.
scenario_zh: 你讲解事务隔离后要选择下一节课。教学学习记录中，学员看过课程，但仅在一个给定时序里正确指出重复读取结果可能变化；其他异常尚未测试。看过材料、声称了解和实际运用是不同证据。

name_zh: 用分阶段迁移保留兼容性
summary_en: Use expand/migrate/contract stages when a broad mechanical change cannot land in independent vertical slices.
summary_zh: 无法独立逐项交付的大规模修改，按扩展、迁移、收缩三个阶段推进。
scenario_en: Rename shared timeout to timeoutMs across packages while old callers remain supported. Teaching dual fields with unequal values fail explicitly. Direct rename breaks remaining consumers, motivating expand→migrate→contract.
scenario_zh: 多个包使用共享字段 timeout，你要迁移到 timeoutMs。教学契约要求旧调用者在迁移期间可用；同时传两字段且值不同须报冲突。直接改名会一次打断所有未迁移调用者，适合用扩展→迁移→收缩。

name_en: Explicit partial and invalid fixture intent
name_zh: 区分不完整样本与故意无效的输入
summary_en: Distinguish incomplete valid fixtures from intentionally invalid input.
summary_zh: 测试中明确哪些样本是有效但不完整，哪些用于验证错误处理。
scenario_en: Test a body-only handler and validator. A valid partial fixture has string body.id; an intentionally invalid one has numeric id. Double casts for both hide intent.
scenario_zh: 测试只读body的处理器和输入校验器。教学有效部分请求含body.id字符串，故意无效样本则为数字id；两者都用双重类型断言会隐藏测试意图。

name_zh: 并行执行就绪任务，逐个集成结果
summary_en: Run independent dependency-ready tasks in isolated contexts and serialize their integration.
summary_zh: 依赖已满足的独立任务可隔离执行，合并时按顺序验证。
scenario_en: Teaching S defines schema, E depends on S and C copy is independent. S may remain tracker-open until final PR closure even after verified integration. Readiness comes from consumable landed state, not closed labels.
scenario_zh: 教学任务 S 定义 schema，E 导出器依赖 S，C 文案独立；集成分支已有清单。跟踪器可能等最终 PR 合并才关闭 S，但 S 代码已经验证并集成，这时就绪状态应来自实际集成而非 closed 标签。

name_en: Mechanics to checks, judgment to review
name_zh: 机械规则交给检查工具，判断留给评审
summary_en: Turn syntactic mistakes into deterministic checks and reserve prose rules for judgment.
summary_zh: 语法和结构问题用自动检查处理，文字规则重点说明需要判断的部分。
scenario_en: Tests repeatedly deep-import implementation code while prompts keep saying use entry points. This mechanical shape belongs in checks; if an existing checker is unwired, repair wiring. Cross-module judgment still belongs in review.
scenario_zh: 团队反复发生测试深导入，提示里不断追加“记得使用入口”。这是固定导入形状，现有检查器若未接CI，应先修接线；跨模块一致性判断仍需评审。

name_zh: 按实际后果选择变更证据
summary_en: Review a change through observed behavior plus reversibility of its real-world consequences.
summary_zh: 既检查行为，也考虑真实后果是否可恢复，再决定评审深度。
scenario_en: A bulk-mail fix removes duplicate recipients. The teaching dry-run has three addresses, two identical. Code can be rolled back, while sent messages generally cannot be recalled. Review evidence must address both behaviors and consequences.
scenario_zh: 批量邮件修复准备上线，旧逻辑给重复地址发送两次，新逻辑应去重。教学演练输入三个地址，其中两个相同。代码可回滚，已经发出的邮件通常不能撤回，评审证据要覆盖这两类后果。

name_zh: 用一次性原型回答具体问题
summary_en: Choose the prototype artifact by the uncertainty it must resolve and expose relevant state.
summary_zh: 根据尚未确定的问题选择原型形式，并暴露需要观察的状态。
scenario_en: Choose whether undo restores only your last edit or an entire object snapshot. Teaching state has title/flag: A, own edit to B, another action changes flag, then undo. An in-memory demo exposes semantics without a real database.
scenario_zh: 你还没决定撤销应只恢复自己的最后修改，还是恢复整个对象快照。教学状态有标题与标记：初始标题 A，自己改 B，另一动作改标记，随后撤销。要观察语义差异，先做小型内存演示，不接真实数据库。

name_zh: 前提确定后再问下一轮问题
summary_en: Ask only decisions whose prerequisites have already settled, then recompute the next round.
summary_zh: 只询问前置条件已经明确的决策，收到答案后重新安排下一轮。
scenario_en: A notification system needs retention and cleanup decisions. Teaching retention permission is unresolved, while provider limits are discoverable in current configuration/docs. Cleanup cadence depends on retention rather than an implicit answer in the same round.
scenario_zh: 通知系统需要决定保留期和清理方式。教学当前资料尚未明确允许保留多久，供应商限额则可从已有配置与文档查到。清理周期依赖保留决定，不应该在同一轮问题里默默假设其答案。

name_en: Question the knowledge owner through a send brief
name_zh: 找到真正掌握信息的人
summary_en: Ask the requester who holds missing knowledge and what decision needs it, then target the actual owner.
summary_zh: 先确认缺什么知识、谁掌握它，以及哪个决策需要答案，再组织询问。
scenario_en: A developer lacks a partner retention rule needed for cache cleanup. Teaching policy and infrastructure owners know permitted retention and deletion mechanism respectively; one recipient may not know both. Repeated guessing questions to the developer do not solve ownership.
scenario_zh: 开发者不知道伙伴的数据保留规则，但需要它决定本地缓存清理。教学中伙伴政策负责人知道允许范围，基础设施负责人知道删除机制；一个人未必能回答全部问题。反复让开发者猜政策不能解决知识归属。

name_zh: 把概念、规则与例外放在一起
summary_en: Keep one concept definition, decision rules and exceptions together after selecting its disclosure tier.
summary_zh: 选定信息层级后，将同一概念的定义、判断规则和例外集中说明。
scenario_en: Write a retry runbook where readers need both candidate-error definitions and a non-idempotent-write exception. Teaching rules treat a transient network failure as a candidate, but a write without idempotency guarantees cannot be retried automatically just because of that failure. Scattering these pieces exposes incomplete rules.
scenario_zh: 你在写重试操作手册，执行者需要同时知道什么是可重试错误以及非幂等写入的例外。教学规则：网络瞬断是候选重试情况；没有幂等保证的写入不能仅凭网络错误自动重试。把定义、资格和例外散放，会让读者只看到其中一段。

name_zh: 按概念记录被否决的方案
summary_en: Recall substantive rejected concepts without poisoning that memory with already implemented requests.
summary_zh: 记住实质上被否决的想法，不把已经执行的用户要求混入拒绝记录。
scenario_en: Triage a night-theme request after finding a closed dark-mode issue. Teaching record A rejected dual-theme maintenance cost; record B closed because the feature already existed. Closed alone does not distinguish these meanings.
scenario_zh: 你在分诊新的“夜间主题”请求，找到一条已关闭的“深色模式”记录。教学记录 A 明确因维护两套主题的成本而否决；记录 B 则因功能已经实现而关闭。仅有 closed 状态不能区分这两种情况。

name_en: Repair the missing premise before shortening
name_zh: 先补充前提，再压缩解释
summary_en: Treat comprehension failure as a missing-context problem before optimizing word count.
summary_zh: 读者没理解时先找缺少的背景，避免只缩短文字而留下同样的障碍。
scenario_en: A reader does not understand why an export ticket waits for a schema change; the explanation only says blocked by dependency. The teaching premise is that the exporter needs customer_code, which the current schema lacks. This missing connection causes the confusion.
scenario_zh: 读者不理解为什么导出票据要等模式变更，原解释只有“被依赖阻塞”。教学前提是导出器读取新字段customer_code，而当前模式尚无该字段；这个缺失连接才是理解障碍。

name_en: Reread shared artifacts before incremental writes
name_zh: 继续写共享文件前先重读
summary_en: Preserve intervening human edits while materializing agreed work incrementally.
summary_zh: 增量写入前读取最新内容，保留其间用户做的修改。
scenario_en: While coauthoring, paragraph A becomes author-edited A2 after your read; you have approved addition B. Rewriting cached A+B would erase A2, so inspect current disk state before writing.
scenario_zh: 你与作者共写文章：读取时第一段为 A，作者随后改为 A2；你已准备一个获准追加的第二段 B。用缓存全文重写会把 A2 覆盖回 A，需要在写入前核对当前文件。

name_zh: 按依赖类型选择验证替代方案
summary_en: Choose verification substitutes according to the dependency controlled by the module.
summary_zh: 根据模块控制的是哪种依赖，选择合适的模拟或替代检查。
scenario_en: An order module computes totals, writes a database and calls a third-party payment service. Testing that a failed payment leaves an order pending requires more than mocking every internal function and asserting calls. First establish dependency ownership and available substitutes.
scenario_zh: 订单模块计算总价、写数据库并调用第三方支付。要测试支付失败时订单保持待支付，不能只模拟每个内部函数然后断言它们被调用。先了解依赖所有权及替身能力。

name_en: Compare structural variants in shared context
name_zh: 在真实环境中比较设计方案
summary_en: Compare design alternatives inside the real host context and hold data constant.
summary_zh: 把方案放到实际使用环境里比较，并保持测试数据一致。
scenario_en: Choose settings structure: grouped page A, sidebar B or item panels C. Teaching data has the same eight settings/long names. Empty isolated images hide real navigation density.
scenario_zh: 选择设置页结构：A为分组页，B为侧边导航，C为逐项面板。教学数据相同，有8个设置与长名称；空白独立截图会隐藏真实导航密度问题。

name_zh: 用不同约束探索不同方案
summary_en: Generate alternatives under intentionally different constraints instead of multiplying identical proposals.
summary_zh: 主动改变设计条件，避免得到多个几乎相同的提案。
scenario_en: Explore file-import interfaces for one shared read/validate/result requirement. Teaching constraints differ: few entrypoints, format extensibility and easy common calls. Best-interface alone can produce near-identical proposals.
scenario_zh: 你在设计文件导入接口，希望看到真正不同的方案。教学共同需求是读取一种文件、校验并返回结果；三份设计分别优化少入口、扩展格式、常见调用简单。只说“最佳接口”可能得到三个近似答案。

name_en: Keep tool roots separate from project roots
name_zh: 区分工具目录和项目目录
summary_en: Resolve installed helper code from its skill base while resolving project artifacts from the declared project working directory.
summary_zh: 工具代码从 Skill 安装目录查找，项目文件从声明的工作目录解析。
scenario_en: Installed brand helper code lives in tools/brand/, while the task reads shop's docs/brand-guidelines.md and produces assets/design-tokens.json. Changing into the helper directory can redirect cwd-based reads and writes into the installed package.
scenario_zh: 已安装的品牌工具代码在 tools/brand/，要读取 shop项目的docs/brand-guidelines.md并生成assets/design-tokens.json。若切换到工具目录运行，依赖cwd的脚本可能把项目数据读写到安装包。

name_en: Persist a master design system with page-specific overrides
name_zh: 保存全局设计规则与页面差异
summary_en: Maintain shared rules once and store page deviations separately, with explicit override, inheritance and missing-file handling.
summary_zh: 共享规则集中维护，页面只保存差异；读取时明确覆盖、继承和文件缺失的处理。
scenario_en: Implement a checkout page using shared typography, text color and button spacing, with larger button padding on this page. Future sessions should retrieve both the shared baseline and this exception rather than guess which complete copy is current.
scenario_zh: 你要实现结账页。项目已有共享字体、文字颜色和按钮间距，但结账页的按钮需要更大的内边距。希望下次会话仍能找到共享规则和这个例外，而不是从多份完整副本中猜哪一份有效。

name_en: Verify a retrieved UI recommendation before reuse
name_zh: 复用界面建议前先核对适用性
summary_en: Treat a retrieved UI suggestion as provisional until its scope and identity fit the request.
summary_zh: 检索到的建议先当作候选，确认适用范围和对象符合当前需求。
scenario_en: A React dialog fails to restore focus to its opener. Teaching C1 is style-pricing-palette mentioning React, while C2 ux-focus-return describes returning focus to an opener that still exists. Catalog items are candidates, not fixes established by a stack keyword.
scenario_zh: React 确认框关闭后焦点没有返回触发按钮，目录检索却可能给配色建议。教学候选 C1=style-pricing-palette，只提 React；C2=ux-focus-return，明确处理关闭后回到仍存在的 opener。目录条目只是候选，不能凭框架名认定能修复。

name_en: Check privacy and evidence usefulness separately
name_zh: 分别检查隐私和证据完整性
summary_en: Verify that an export is scrubbed and independently verify that its remaining evidence still supports its claims.
summary_zh: 导出时既确认敏感信息已清除，也确认剩余证据仍能支撑结论。
scenario_en: A scrubbed failure bundle withholds sensitive tool results. Privacy CLEAN does not mean its database-cause finding remains supported within the export. Check these goals separately.
scenario_zh: 失败分析包脱敏后，敏感工具结果被隐藏。隐私扫描CLEAN不表示“数据库导致故障”的结论仍有包内证据；两种目标需分别检查。

name_en: Record reversible decisions with their rationale and cost
name_zh: 记录决策理由和改错成本
summary_en: Record an authorized implementation decision, its evidence and cost if wrong, then include it in the final handoff.
summary_zh: 记录已授权的选择、依据和判断错误后的代价，并写入交接说明。
scenario_en: An approved local plan alternates normalizeRow/normalizeRecord while its spec defines the same behavior and only internal callers are affected. Make a reversible naming choice reviewable rather than deriving publish/security permission from adjudication.
scenario_zh: 已批准本地计划交替使用 normalizeRow 和 normalizeRecord，但规格明确行为相同，两个名称只影响内部调用。你可以在可逆范围内选定一致名字，同时让选择可审阅；不能因这种裁定能力推导发布或安全权限。

name_en: Preserve linkage with stable redaction placeholders
name_zh: 用一致的脱敏占位符保留关联
summary_en: Use consistent substitutions across an export while retaining safe identity and evidence structure.
summary_zh: 同一敏感对象始终使用相同替代值，同时保留安全的关联结构。
scenario_en: One private account repeats across report/trace, while distinct accounts may collapse into REDACTED and lose linkage. Teaching substitutions operate on export copies only.
scenario_zh: 同一私有账号在报告和轨迹重复出现，两个不同账号也可能被统一替成REDACTED而丢关联。教学替换要稳定且不碰原始受控资料。

name_en: Qualify observations by when they were captured
name_zh: 说明观察结果来自哪个时间点
summary_en: Distinguish historical evidence, unverified snapshots, current observations and unknown state.
summary_zh: 区分历史证据、未验证快照、当前观察和未知状态。
scenario_en: Investigate which skill influenced last month’s session. Teaching materials include a captured body/digest and today’s HEAD. Current checkout cannot authenticate a past installation, and missing original paths do not erase preserved copies.
scenario_zh: 调查上个月会话用了哪个Skill版本。教学材料有会话捕获的正文及摘要，另有今天HEAD；今日检出不能认证过去安装，也不能因原路径消失就忽略保留副本。

name_zh: 围绕一个主题持续追问
summary_en: Ask one focused follow-up at a time until the current topic stops producing new information.
summary_zh: 每次只问一个聚焦问题，直到当前主题不再产生新信息。
scenario_en: A founder says we care about quality without an incident, then teaching context adds a customer launch delayed by missing deployment steps. Elicit grounded positioning rather than turn a vague phrase into a settled value proposition.
scenario_zh: 创始人说“我们重视质量”，但还没给具体事件。教学回答后来补充“客户因部署步骤缺失推迟上线”。你希望从真实答案提炼定位，而不是把一句泛话改成已经确认的价值主张。

name_zh: 让所有评审者检查同一份产物
summary_en: When required by the workflow, require every independent reviewer to pass the same artifact against the same rubric.
summary_zh: 流程要求多方通过时，所有评审者应按同一标准检查同一版本。
scenario_en: The teaching workflow requires two independent passes on one release note/rubric. A passes v1, B passes v2, which still contains an unsupported benchmark. Different-version passes cannot be combined.
scenario_zh: 流程明确要求两位独立评审对同一发布说明按同一标准通过。教学 v1 有一位 PASS，v2 另一位 PASS，但后一版本还有无来源 benchmark 主张；不能把不同版本的两份通过拼起来。

name_zh: 入队前一次性预留预算
summary_en: Reserve the permitted budget atomically before accepting expensive queued work.
summary_zh: 接收高成本任务前，原子地预留允许使用的预算。
scenario_en: A generation service has 10 teaching budget units left. Two simultaneous requests each estimate 6 units. If the front door only reads balance and workers charge later, both can be admitted. In-flight commitments must be handled at the shared budget boundary.
scenario_zh: 生成服务只剩10个教学预算单位，两条同时到达的请求各估算6单位。若入口只查余额、worker才记账，两条请求都可能被接受。需要在共享预算边界处理并发承诺。

name_zh: 区分阅读、参与和发送权限
summary_en: Keep audience trust, permission to participate and permission to deliver as separate checks.
summary_zh: 能看信息、能参与讨论和能向外发送，是三个独立的授权问题。
scenario_en: A group named Internal has authenticated external identity. Historical agent replies do not authorize responding to a human-directed question or posting internal traces.
scenario_zh: 群聊显示名叫Internal，但真实适配器身份属于外部频道。Agent在历史中出现，也不表示本次对人的提问允许它发内部调试轨迹。

name_en: Bind Behavioral Specs to Enforcement and Tests
name_zh: 把行为要求绑定到执行点和测试
summary_en: Give a mined behavior a stable identity tied to its actual enforcement point and retain explicit test and uncertainty references.
summary_zh: 为要求分配稳定标识，关联实际执行位置，并保留测试和不确定性记录。
scenario_en: Document existing order behavior while renaming the display heading from Reject empty order to Empty-order validation. Teaching code shows Checkout synchronously calling OrderService.validateEmptyOrder, which throws EMPTY for empty lines; OrderServiceTests.rejectEmptyOrder covers an empty array. Another asynchronous consumer is unread.
scenario_zh: 你在整理已有订单行为，准备把展示标题“拒绝空订单”改成“空订单校验”。教学代码显示 Checkout 同步调用 OrderService.validateEmptyOrder，后者在 lines 为空时抛出 EMPTY；已有测试 OrderServiceTests.rejectEmptyOrder 覆盖空数组。另一个异步消费者尚未读取。

name_zh: 先检查不能妥协的阻塞项
summary_en: Apply declared non-negotiable blockers before deriving a readiness decision from an aggregate quality score.
summary_zh: 先应用硬性门槛，再判断综合分数是否足以交付。
scenario_en: A teaching audit totals 95, but a sensitive endpoint lacks a required authorization gate. An adopted blocker policy prevents delivery regardless of documentation/performance scores.
scenario_zh: 教学审计总分95，但敏感数据接口缺少项目规定的授权门禁。独立阻塞政策已经要求不得交付，不能用文档或性能分抵消。

name_en: Conditioned Description Is Not Independent Validation
name_zh: 知道答案后的描述不算独立验证
summary_en: Label a judgment that was given the measured answer as conditioned description rather than independent corroboration.
summary_zh: 评分者已看到被测答案时，应标为有条件的描述，不能当成独立佐证。
scenario_en: A media measurement supplies teaching contrast 34, then a model receives 34 and describes it. Repeating 34 is conditioned explanation, not a second independent measurement.
scenario_zh: 媒体测量给出教学对比度指标34，随后把34输入模型让其描述。模型重复34是依据已有结果的说明，并非第二次独立测量。

name_zh: 从多个 Skill 中提炼可执行规则
summary_en: Promote only recurring actionable principles with a stated failure consequence and a comparison against existing rules.
summary_zh: 只提炼重复出现、能指导行动的原则，并说明失败后果与已有规则的区别。
scenario_en: Three skills repeat source retention while another has one vendor command. Distillation selects transferable actions, not every heading as policy.
scenario_zh: 三份Skill都强调复用证据保留来源，一份只有厂商命令。全局规则提炼应选可迁移行为，不能每个标题都变一条新政策。

name_zh: 审计结论要能指导下一步
summary_en: Make keep, improve, retire and merge verdicts state the evidence, action and replacement rather than a vague label.
summary_zh: 保留、改进、撤下和合并都要说明证据、具体动作与替代方案。
scenario_en: Audit overlapping deployment skills A/B and stale wrapper C. Overlap/too long labels do not guide implementation; dispositions need destinations, retained content and reasons.
scenario_zh: 审计重叠部署Skill A/B和旧包装C，结论只有“重叠”“太长”无法指导实施。教学处置需要明确迁往何处、保留什么与为何。

name_zh: 先用确定性解析，再处理疑难项
summary_en: Run a deterministic parser first and send only structurally uncertain items for model review.
summary_zh: 先运行普通解析器，仅把结构不确定的记录交给模型判断。
scenario_en: Convert regularly formatted quiz text into structured data. Teaching Q1 contains a question, A/B/C choices and answer B; Q2 has the same fields but no answer. Preserve determinate extraction without asking the model to invent an answer from general knowledge.
scenario_zh: 把格式稳定的试题文本转成结构化数据。教学输入Q1含题干、A/B/C选项及答案B；Q2含相同字段但没有答案。要保留可确定的提取结果，不能让模型凭常识替原文补答案。

name_en: One Canonical Owner per Documentation Fact
name_zh: 每条长期事实只由一处维护
summary_en: Assign each durable fact to one document role and reference it from other views.
summary_zh: 把事实分配给一个明确的文档位置，其他页面通过引用复用。
scenario_en: README, an architecture map and a weekly report give completed, blocked and in-progress statuses for the same auth migration. The teaching project uses STATUS.md for live state, ARCHITECTURE.md for structure and DECISIONS.md for decisions. Establish actual state and its maintained owner.
scenario_zh: README、架构图和周报重复写认证迁移状态，三处分别说完成、阻塞和进行中。教学项目已有 STATUS.md 负责当前状态、ARCHITECTURE.md 负责结构、DECISIONS.md 记录决定。需要先核实真实状态，再让读者知道一项事实由哪处维护。

name_en: Drain Completion before Stopping the Observer
name_zh: 收齐完成事件后再停止监听
summary_en: Keep the completion observer alive while its producer finalizes pending work.
summary_zh: 产生结果的进程还在收尾时，保持观察者运行，避免漏掉最后的完成事件。
scenario_en: Capture run-a finalizes after stopping; its artifact event can arrive later. Teaching logs also contain old run-b exported. Wait for run-a's own terminal state without killing observation early or accepting stale evidence.
scenario_zh: 采集任务 run-a 停止后还要导出，产物事件可能晚于采集进程结束。教学日志还含旧 run-b 的 exported 事件；本轮只等待 run-a 的终态。过早结束观察者会丢掉最后证据，看到旧事件也不能算本次完成。

name_zh: 昂贵评分前先排除不合格项
summary_en: Remove provably ineligible candidates before spending on ranking or model enrichment.
summary_zh: 先过滤确定不符合条件的候选，再投入排名或模型处理成本。
scenario_en: Retrieved candidates go to scoring but teaching inputs include duplicate C1, disallowed C2 and C3 missing permission metadata. Obtain only authorized eligibility metadata rather than sending all bodies and hiding forbidden output later.
scenario_zh: 检索结果要送去评分，但教学候选包含 C1 的重复副本、C2 不允许来源、C3 权限元数据缺失。你只可取得资格判断所需且已允许的元数据，不能先把全部正文给模型再在答案里隐藏禁用项。

name_zh: 有足够证据后再推广经验规则
summary_en: Promote a local learned behavior only after checking recurrence, scope and counter-evidence.
summary_zh: 推广局部经验前，检查是否重复出现、适用范围和反面证据。
scenario_en: Two independent services support boundary validation while a React folder convention fits one project only. Promotion needs compatible triggers/actions/scope/corrections, not session confidence.
scenario_zh: 两个独立服务都发现外部输入校验可防错误处理，另有React目录约定只在一项目有效。推广经验需比较触发、行动、范围与反面纠正，不用会话自信值代替。

name_zh: 发布的必须是实际验证过的版本
summary_en: Keep the identity of the tested artifact unchanged through staging, publication and promotion, and read it back.
summary_zh: 测试、暂存和发布使用同一份产物，并回读确认内容没变。
scenario_en: A release tests archive A but rebuilds B under the same version before publishing. Dependencies/environment may alter bytes even without source changes. Preserve tested artifact identity through promotion, separately from release authorization.
scenario_zh: 发布流程测试了归档 A，却在发布前重建 B并沿用同一版本号。即使源码没变，依赖或生成环境也可能改变字节。教学任务要让实际提升的产物保持已验证身份；发布本身仍需要相应授权。

name_zh: 根据失败代价选择评测指标
summary_en: Choose evaluation metrics according to the decision and the cost of its failure modes before optimizing a score.
summary_zh: 先明确要做的决策和各类错误的代价，再选择指标并优化分数。
scenario_en: An alert dataset has 100 cases:98 routine and 2 urgent. Missing urgency is costly, yet always-routine gets 98% accuracy. That value alone cannot justify deployment.
scenario_zh: 提醒分类样本100条，其中98常规、2紧急。漏紧急代价高，始终判常规也有98%准确率，不能仅凭这个值选择部署。

name_zh: 用具体样例文件说明项目约定
summary_en: Anchor project conventions to current concrete exemplar files, with explicit differences and anti-patterns.
summary_zh: 指向当前可用的范例，说明应遵循的部分、例外和反面做法。
scenario_en: Add a connector to a legacy project with inconsistent exemplars. Teaching file A shows current registration, B bounded retries, and old C swallows errors and returns success. Maintained guidance explicitly supersedes C's structure. Inherit valid conventions without copying its defect.
scenario_zh: 旧项目新增一个连接器，现有样例不完全一致。教学文件 A 展示当前注册接口，B 展示有上限的重试，旧文件 C 吞掉异常且返回成功；维护说明已确认 C 的结构被替代。你希望继承有效约定，不复制旧缺陷。

name_zh: 让批准只对应具体草稿和目标
summary_en: Bind approval to the exact draft bytes, destination and current revision so stale decisions cannot release rewritten text.
summary_zh: 将批准绑定到确切内容、目标位置和当前版本，防止旧批准放行改写后的内容。
scenario_en: An operator approves v1 while an agent shortens it to v2. approved=true can release changed text/targets; teaching decisions bind exact drafts.
scenario_zh: 供应商回复v1被批准时，Agent正缩短为v2。若只存approved=true，旧决定可能放行新文字或新目标；教学批准必须绑定确切草稿。

name_zh: 用独立参考点验证坐标校准
summary_en: Collect enough independent anchors to identify a coordinate transform, then verify it on a separate reference.
summary_zh: 用足够的独立锚点求出坐标变换，再用另一组参考点验证。
scenario_en: Positioning an annotation in a document editor requires converting screen locations to document coordinates. Teaching y references are document 100→screen 250 and document 300→screen 650, with independent document 200→screen 450. Assume unrotated aligned axes, but unknown scale and origin.
scenario_zh: 在文档编辑器放置注释，需要把屏幕位置换算为文档坐标。教学y轴参考为文档100对应屏幕250、文档300对应屏幕650，另有独立参考文档200对应屏幕450。假定轴对齐无旋转，但比例和原点尚未知。

name_zh: 区分没有匹配与检索未完成
summary_en: Report incomplete retrieval separately from a complete search with no matches.
summary_zh: 检索尚未完成时明确说明，避免把部分结果当成完整的空结果。
scenario_en: An approval search returns zero matches, but diagnostics say decision-17.md was unreadable. The teaching scope contains only the permitted task decision directory. Distinguish complete scoped absence from insufficient evidence instead of translating a read error into no approval.
scenario_zh: 你检索一项批准记录，扫描器返回零命中，但诊断显示 decision-17.md 无法读取。教学扫描范围仅含这项任务允许访问的决策目录。需要区别“在完整范围内没找到”与“还无法判断”，不能把错误折算成没有批准。

name_en: Keep the Stop Supervisor Outside the Worker
name_zh: 把停止监督放在工作任务之外
summary_en: Run the liveness deadline and stop decision in a separately controlled supervisor that remains available when the worker stalls.
summary_zh: 让独立监督者管理总时限和停止决定，任务卡住时仍能发出停止信号。
scenario_en: Authorized unattended worker-a stalls in a tool call and configured heartbeats stop. Teaching deadlines, identity and allowed stop policy were established before launch. Missing heartbeat does not automatically prove compromise or complete failure.
scenario_zh: 已授权无人值守任务 worker-a 卡在长调用里，配置心跳没有继续。教学启动前已明确监督期限、当前进程身份和可使用的停止策略；缺心跳不是自动证明遭入侵或所有工作失败。

name_zh: 根据缺失信息逐步补充上下文
summary_en: Refine retrieved context using explicit missing-information notes instead of choosing a fixed file set upfront.
summary_zh: 每轮记录还缺什么，再调整读取范围，避免一开始就固定文件集合。
scenario_en: Add rate limiting to API endpoints. The first rate limit search misses implementation, but middleware mentions throttle. The teaching project has middleware/index.ts referencing throttle.ts and router.ts wiring middleware. Inspect these materials before choosing reuse or new code.
scenario_zh: 你要给 API 端点接入限流，第一次搜索 rate limit 没找到实现，但中间件入口提到 throttle。教学项目中 middleware/index.ts 引用 throttle.ts，router.ts 给路由接入中间件；需要核对这些实际材料再判断是复用还是新增。

name_en: Preserve Behavioral Control Semantics Across Localization
name_zh: 翻译时保留操作约束
summary_en: Preserve operational controls in agent instructions when translating or adapting prose.
summary_zh: 翻译 Agent 指令时，保留权限、条件和停止规则的实际含义。
scenario_en: Localize review instructions but omit proof for high-severity claims and zero-finding acceptance. Matching headings/terms can still change behavior; frozen language versions contain such differences.
scenario_zh: 把评审指令译为中文，保留标题和严重级别，却遗漏“高严重性需具体触发证据”和“零发现可通过”。流畅译文也会改变评审动作；冻结语言版本确有这类不一致。

name_zh: 说明测量到底统计了什么
summary_en: State what a measurement actually counts before using it as evidence for a different resource or behavior.
summary_zh: 先声明计数单位和范围，再用结果支撑其他资源或行为方面的判断。
scenario_en: A JSONL snapshot totals 1,000 bytes with 800 attachment bytes. Asked about remaining context, this measures persisted storage, not active tokens/headroom.
scenario_zh: JSONL快照共1,000字节，附件记录800字节。用户问模型还剩多少上下文，这个存储统计只能回答落盘占比，不能推出活跃token或剩余空间。

name_zh: 复用记忆前检查时效和替代关系
summary_en: Check current authority and explicit supersession before reusing a saved decision.
summary_zh: 确认记录是否仍有权威性，以及是否已被新的决定明确替代。
scenario_en: Old release decision M1 retains its bytes/hash, but the current issue records rollback and M2 explicitly withdraws it. Answer present state rather than replaying M1 approval. Teaching records share one candidate task, with inspectable timestamps and supersession.
scenario_zh: 你找到一份旧发布决定 M1，保存字节与散列完好；后来当前 issue 已记录回滚，M2 明确撤回旧决定。需要回答现在的状态，而不是重复 M1 的批准。教学记录都属于同一候选任务，时间与替代关系可核对。

name_zh: 检查相关输入之间的结果关系
summary_en: Check defined relationships between transformed inputs and outputs when exact fixtures alone leave broad behavior unchecked.
summary_zh: 除固定样本外，还检查输入变换后输出应满足的关系。
scenario_en: A normalizer sorts without dropping records; teaching IDs are b,a,c. A single two-record example misses order dependence/loss, so add contract-supported relational predicates.
scenario_zh: 规范化工具应排序且保留所有记录，教学输入ID为b,a,c。单个两条样例可能漏掉输入排列相关或丢记录错误，需要契约支持的关系判据。

name_zh: 检查完整动作顺序和最终状态
summary_en: Trace the complete action sequence and verify its final state, including later actions that undo earlier ones.
summary_zh: 追踪全部动作，特别是后续操作是否撤销了前面的结果。
scenario_en: A mail interface's New Email button must clear the selected thread and open the composer. Teaching action selectThread(null) also sets composeOpen=false. Opening before clearing therefore closes the panel again.
scenario_zh: 邮件界面的“新邮件”按钮需清空选中会话并打开撰写面板。教学动作selectThread(null)同时把composeOpen设为false；因此先打开再清空会话会使面板重新关闭。

name_en: Observe a Blocked Worker from a Separate Control Path
name_zh: 用独立路径观察卡住的任务
summary_en: Observe a blocked task through an independent read-only path that does not depend on that task making progress.
summary_zh: 选择不依赖该任务继续运行的只读路径，获取它的实际状态。
scenario_en: W1 waits on C5, so an in-queue status command also waits. Teaching snapshot at UTC10:05 contains C5 at 10:00 with no matching result in inspected scope. That is scoped observation, not proof of global deadlock.
scenario_zh: 工作者 W1 等待调用 C5，发到自身队列的状态指令也排在后面。教学快照观察时刻为 UTC 10:05，读取范围里有 10:00 的 C5但没有匹配结果；这说明该范围中的未匹配状态，不直接证明全局卡死。

name_en: Compare Candidate and Baseline on the Same Trial Panel
name_zh: 用同一组试验比较候选和基线
summary_en: Use the same declared trials for candidate and baseline and retain each paired result before applying an aggregate gate.
summary_zh: 保存每次配对结果，再按预先声明的整体标准判断。
scenario_en: Trials 1/2 give candidate 0.9/0.5 and baseline 0.8/0.6. Best-versus-worst cherry-picking creates 0.3 while paired mean difference is 0.
scenario_zh: 用试验1、2比较提示：候选0.9/0.5，基线0.8/0.6。挑候选最好与基线最差可制造0.3收益，但同组配对平均差实际为0。

name_zh: 只使用决策时点已知的信息
summary_en: Admit only information available at the decision time when replaying or evaluating a historical task.
summary_zh: 回放历史任务时，不引入当时还不可用的后续信息。
scenario_en: Evaluate an incident assistant at a 10:05 decision cutoff after the root cause is known. Teaching R1 occurred and became available at 10:02; R2 occurred at 10:03 but was readable only at 10:12; postmortem R3 was published at 11:00. Later facts may inform labels, not historical input.
scenario_zh: 你评估事故助手在 10:05 决策时点能否合理排查，后来已知道根因。教学材料：R1 事件/可得时间均为 10:02；R2 事件 10:03，但记录到 10:12 才可读；复盘 R3 在 11:00 发布。未来信息可以作评测参考，不能偷偷进入历史输入。

name_zh: 前置检查失败时撤销依赖它的通过结论
summary_en: Revoke downstream passes that depend on a prerequisite which failed its own validation.
summary_zh: 某项前提验证失败后，所有依赖它的检查结果都要重新判断。
scenario_en: Audit A, B, C and independent D: B requires valid A and C requires B. If B passes first but A later fails ordering, raw A events cannot sustain B/C.
scenario_zh: 审核步骤A、B、C及独立D，B依赖有效A，C依赖B。教学初评先让B通过，后来A自身顺序检查失败；B、C不能继续借A的原始事件维持通过。

name_zh: 分开保存原始证据与解释
summary_en: Store original statements separately from interpretations, candidate formulations and unresolved contradictions.
summary_zh: 原始陈述单独保存，解释、候选表述和未解决的矛盾另行记录。
scenario_en: Two stakeholders describe one feature's audience differently. Teaching A says 'Start with startups; one administrator can configure it.' B says 'Start with enterprises; procurement and security teams participate.' Statements do not automatically establish a settled product position.
scenario_zh: 两位利益相关者对功能受众给出不同回答。教学原话 A：“先帮助创业团队，管理员一个人就能设置。”；B：“先面向大企业，采购和安全团队都要参与。”这些是陈述，不自动等于已确认的产品定位。

name_zh: 区分重试后成功与每次都可靠
summary_en: Distinguish succeeding once with retries from succeeding on every repeated trial.
summary_zh: 一次经过重试的成功，不能证明所有重复试验都能成功。
scenario_en: Three runs of one teaching routing fixture yield pass, fail, fail. That satisfies at-least-one-within-three but not all-three success; operational questions differ.
scenario_zh: 同一教学路由夹具跑三次，结果通过、失败、失败。它满足“三次内至少一次成功”，却不满足“三次全部成功”；运营问题不同，名称不能互换。

name_zh: 先查已有方案，再决定是否自建
summary_en: Check existing local and external solutions before writing a new utility, then explain the chosen reuse strategy.
summary_zh: 检查本地和外部可用方案，说明最终采用、扩展、组合或自建的理由。
scenario_en: A docs repository needs link checks; its maintained script covers href/fragments but not language destinations. The teaching environment can inspect local code only, with registries unavailable. Choose adopt/extend/compose/build without treating absent channels as no solution anywhere.
scenario_zh: 文档仓库需要死链检查，已有维护脚本支持 href/fragment，但没有语言目标判断。教学环境当前只能检查本地仓库，外部注册源不可用。你要选择采用、扩展、组合或自建，不把渠道缺失写成所有方案都不存在。

name_en: Evidence Bound to the Same Stable Bytes
name_zh: 让证据对应同一份稳定内容
summary_en: Ensure measurements, sizes and digests in an evidence bundle describe the same stable source content.
summary_zh: 证据包中的大小、摘要和测量都应描述同一版本的源文件。
scenario_en: A video receipt records digest, byte count and duration. The teaching source is replaced from A to B during collection. Hashing A and probing B creates a complete-looking receipt that describes no single consistent content version.
scenario_zh: 视频证据回执记录文件摘要、字节数和时长。教学源在采集期间由版本A替换成B；若先哈希A再探测B，回执虽字段齐全，却不描述任何一份一致内容。

name_zh: 按当前项目和权限读取记忆
summary_en: Bind memory recall to the current project, recipient and permitted scopes.
summary_zh: 回忆内容必须符合当前项目、接收对象及允许的范围。
scenario_en: Work in frontend repository A and Python repository B; the current handoff is for B's team. Teaching memory contains A's React preference, B's interface decision and private user notes. Allowed scope is B project/team only. High search scores do not automatically admit other scopes.
scenario_zh: 你同时处理前端仓库 A 和 Python 仓库 B，当前要给 B 写团队交接。教学记忆库有 A 的 React 偏好、B 的团队接口决定和用户私人笔记；当前允许范围只含 B 的 project/team。检索分数高不能让其他范围的内容自动进入交接。

name_zh: 过滤由自动化自己产生的反馈事件
summary_en: Identify automated output events and exclude them before they recreate the workflow that produced them.
summary_zh: 识别自动输出，避免它再次触发生成它的流程，形成循环。
scenario_en: A learning observer's reads/writes enter its own queue, generating more observers. Teaching regular interactive events should remain recorded while explicitly automated child events are filtered before metadata or new analysis creation.
scenario_zh: 学习观察器读取自己的工具事件，读写又进入学习队列，会不断生成新观察任务。教学链允许普通交互事件被记录，但观察子运行携带明确 automated 标记，需要在创建项目元数据或新分析之前过滤。

name_en: Process Success and Semantic Completion Handshake
name_zh: 同时确认进程退出和任务完成
summary_en: Require both successful process exit and a task-completion record before acknowledging background work.
summary_zh: 后台进程退出成功后，还需找到任务完成记录，才能报告完成。
scenario_en: A background analyzer processes an observation snapshot. Teaching run R7 reports an unreadable input but exits 0. Treating that as success and archiving the only pending input loses work.
scenario_zh: 后台分析器处理一份观察记录。教学运行R7因读不到输入而报告阻塞，却退出0；主进程若把它当成功并归档唯一输入，就丢失了待处理工作。

name_zh: 整体指标和重要子任务都要达标
summary_en: Evaluate important task slices beside aggregate metrics using gates declared before inspecting the result.
summary_zh: 除总体分数外，分别检查重要任务类型，并在看结果前确定门槛。
scenario_en: A bilingual assistant passes 95/100 while all five Chinese cases fail.95% overall does not establish the promised language capability.
scenario_zh: 双语助手100例通过95，恰好全败的5例都为中文。整体95%无法证明已承诺中文能力可用，需要同时看预定语言分组。

name_zh: 从真实文章提炼写作风格
summary_en: Extract a compact style profile from real writing and reuse it across related outputs.
summary_zh: 提取简短的风格说明，在相关输出中复用。
scenario_en: An author supplies five short samples, and you need release notes and a newsletter for one launch. The shortened teaching samples are S1 'Bulk export added. Administrators can enable it in settings.'; S2 'Checks cover three input classes; mobile is untested.'; S3 'Read the rules, then choose the next step.'; S4 'Only ordering changes; the interface stays the same.'; S5 'Two of ten checks failed; records are in the appendix.'
scenario_zh: 你有作者提供的五篇短稿，需要为同一次发布写说明和通讯，想保留真实写作习惯。以下是缩短的教学样稿：S1“新增批量导出。管理员可在设置中启用。”；S2“测试覆盖三类输入，尚未测试移动端。”；S3“先读取规则，再选择下一步。”；S4“这次只改变排序，接口保持原样。”；S5“十次检查里两次失败，记录见附表。”

name_zh: 结合结构化状态和页面证据
summary_en: Combine structured application state with rendered evidence when neither alone answers the task.
summary_zh: 任何一类证据单独不足时，同时检查应用状态和实际渲染结果。
scenario_en: Check whether prop crate contacts surface floor in a3D scene. Teaching frame 12 appears grounded from the camera, but structured state puts crate's lowest world z at 0.08 and floor at z=0. Geometry and visible appearance both matter.
scenario_zh: 检查三维场景中道具crate与地面floor是否接触。教学帧12从镜头看像接触，但结构记录显示crate最低点世界z=0.08，floor在z=0。需要同时判断几何位置与可见效果。

name_zh: 区分代码现状与产品要求
summary_en: Keep discovered implementation behavior separate from intended business constraints and explicit assumptions.
summary_zh: 把实际实现、预期业务约束和明确假设分开说明。
scenario_en: A developer asks for export functionality, and the existing query has LIMIT 100. The teaching note only says the first list screen fetches 100 rows; it contains no export entitlement policy. You can establish current list behavior without claiming free users have a 100-row export allowance.
scenario_zh: 开发者要求增加导出功能，你发现现有查询使用 LIMIT 100。教学材料中查询说明只写“列表首屏取 100 行”，没有导出权益规则；因此能确认当前列表行为，不能据此断言免费用户只能导出 100 行。

name_zh: 先完成一条小而完整的用户路径
summary_en: Build one small end-to-end user path from the existing specification before expanding all layers.
summary_zh: 从现有规格中选一个可验证的端到端流程，跑通后再扩展。
scenario_en: An MVP accepts, stores and displays requests, with request-a and invalid-input behavior specified. Deliver this one complete path before implementing all models/views and discovering disconnected contracts.
scenario_zh: MVP 要接受请求、保存并显示状态，规格已明确一种 request-a 及输入错误反馈。你可以先交付这条端到端路径，避免先写所有模型和所有页面后才发现接口接不上。

name_zh: 写入前校验拟修改的内容
summary_en: Validate the content an operation proposes to write before authorizing that operation.
summary_zh: 批准操作前先检查它将写入什么，避免只根据操作名称判断。
scenario_en: A tool request replaces a10-line note with 900 lines under an 800-line teaching policy. Inspecting the existing disk file would allow it because the policy concerns the proposed content.
scenario_zh: 工具请求把现有10行笔记替换为900行，本地教学政策限制800行。检查磁盘旧文件会放行这个请求，因为约束对象应是写入后的内容。

name_en: Preserve Literal Examples Across Invocation Templates
name_zh: 保留调用模板中的示例字面值
summary_en: Keep example-language syntax separate from the host's invocation-template syntax.
summary_zh: 区分示例语言语法和宿主调用模板语法，避免错误替换。
scenario_en: A skill shows PostgreSQL $1 binding while a host may expand positional invocation markers. /review alice can transform SQL before the model receives it; inspect both language/template layers.
scenario_zh: Skill正文演示PostgreSQL绑定占位$1，宿主可能先把它当调用位置参数展开。教学/review alice后模型看到的SQL可能已被改；示例语言与模板两层需核。

name_zh: 翻译说明时保留可执行标识符
summary_en: Separate translated explanation from literal symbols used by an instruction loader or reference resolver.
summary_zh: 解释文字可以翻译，指令加载器和引用解析器使用的名称必须原样保留。
scenario_en: Translation-only release-check has parsed name, invocation $release-check and reference references/checklist.md. Chinese prose is allowed; translated keys/paths break consumers.
scenario_zh: 只授权翻译release-check，已知name、调用$release-check及references/checklist.md均由机器解析。解释文字可中文，改字段键或路径却会破发现有引用。

name_zh: 隔离可选能力的加载失败
summary_en: Load optional infrastructure behind the capability boundary and expose its failure honestly.
summary_zh: 在能力边界内加载可选组件；失败时明确说明，并避免影响其他功能。
scenario_en: A partially installed toolkit retains its source reader but lacks a changed-file tracker. A top-level tracker import in the shared entry can prevent the reader from starting. Returning an empty list on failure instead misreports unavailable tracking as no changes.
scenario_zh: 部分安装的工具包仍有源码读取器，却缺少改动文件追踪模块。共享入口若顶层加载追踪器，会使读取器也无法启动；吞掉错误返回空列表又会把不可用误报为没有改动。

name_zh: 按具体版本查询文档
summary_en: Resolve the exact library and requested version before using retrieved API guidance.
summary_zh: 确认库名和所需版本后，再使用检索到的 API 指引。
scenario_en: Integrate middleware while remembering an example from another major version. The teaching lockfile resolves fictional example-web 2.4, and the user requires staying on 2.x. Documentation lists 1.x and 2.x. Similar names or high ranking do not replace version checks.
scenario_zh: 项目要接入中间件，但你记得的是另一个主版本的例子。教学项目锁文件显示框架 example-web 2.4，用户要求保持 2.x；文档目录同时有 1.x 与 2.x。名称相似和搜索排名靠前都不能代替版本核对。

name_zh: 修订时保留已接受的要求
summary_en: Carry accepted requirements into later revisions while preserving the amendment history.
summary_zh: 后续版本继续履行已接受的要求，同时记录每次修订。
scenario_en: Design review R1 accepted keyboard access and visible focus; engineering review R2 changes loading. Update the current plan without retaining only the latest reviewer's suggestions. Teaching obligations are tied to their accepted revision.
scenario_zh: 设计审查 R1 已接受键盘操作和可见焦点要求，工程审查 R2 要调整加载方式。你需要更新当前计划，又不能让新版本只剩最新审查者的建议。教学记录把每项接受的要求与其来源版本相连。

name_en: Separate behavior success from intervention benefit
name_zh: 区分任务成功与新增指令的收益
summary_en: Report whether the requested behavior works separately from whether an added instruction improves it.
summary_zh: 分别说明目标行为是否完成，以及新增指令是否带来改善。
scenario_en: Baseline and overlay both complete three teaching behaviors. ON success shows task capability, not added benefit; tools/cost can still regress.
scenario_zh: 基础提示和新增overlay都完成三项教学行为。ON组全对说明它能做任务，却不说明overlay比OFF提高；额外工具调用或成本仍可能变差。

name_zh: 为能力有限的宿主提供精简指令
summary_en: Give hosts that can read instruction files but cannot run the full skill suite a small, versioned behavioral core.
summary_zh: 只能读指令文件、不能运行完整 Skill 套件的工具，使用小型、有版本的行为核心。
scenario_en: Teaching host H reads project instruction files but cannot discover slash skills or call suite-specific tools. Offer guidance it can follow rather than implying a full workflow is installed. Digest v1 covers inspecting existing code, evidence-based status and user scope; 2 KiB is this example's byte budget.
scenario_zh: 团队的宿主 H 能读取项目指令文件，但不能发现斜杠 Skill 或调用套件专用工具。你要提供可遵循的行为摘要，而不是粘贴全套工作流并暗示能力已安装。教学摘要 v1 的核心是先查现有实现、按证据报告状态、遵守用户范围；2 KiB 是本例的字节预算。

name_zh: 只比较覆盖范围一致的趋势
summary_en: Compare result trends only when the covered checks and measurement conditions match.
summary_zh: 检查范围和测量条件可比时，才把结果作为趋势比较。
scenario_en: Yesterday’s score 6 covered test+lint; today’s9 covers test only. Apparent improvement may come from omitting failing lint.
scenario_zh: 昨日仪表盘6分覆盖test+lint，今天9分只测test。总分改变可能来自省掉失败lint，而非代码质量提高。

name_en: Budget context by when it loads
name_zh: 按加载时机分别计算上下文开销
summary_en: Measure always-loaded metadata separately from the full content eagerly loaded for one invocation.
summary_zh: 区分始终加载的元信息和单次调用时完整加载的正文。
scenario_en: A pack shrinks an entrypoint from 20 KiB to 2 KiB but requires another 18-KiB reference on every invocation. Teaching always-loaded name/description totals 0.4 KiB; full front matter is inventoried separately but included in the body ledger. Compare consumed content rather than equating file shrinkage with token savings.
scenario_zh: Skill 包把入口从 20 KiB 缩到 2 KiB，却要求每次调用额外读取 18 KiB 参考。教学宿主始终加载的 name/description 为 0.4 KiB；完整 front matter 另作清单，调用正文已包含它。你要比较实际加载负担，不把文件变短等同于 token 节省。

name_en: Keep claims within the observed channel
name_zh: 结论不能超出实际观察范围
summary_en: Preserve a finding's evidence limits in every summary and proposed regression assertion.
summary_zh: 摘要和回归断言都保留原证据的验证边界。
scenario_en: A browser teaching probe logs one console Error: quota without pageerror/crash evidence. Headlines cannot claim a crash, and proposed regressions cannot listen only for exceptions.
scenario_zh: 浏览器教学探测记录一次console消息“Error: quota”，没有pageerror或崩溃观察。标题不能写应用崩溃，拟议测试也不能只监听异常通道。

name_en: Revoke the prior grant when narrowing access
name_zh: 缩小权限时撤销旧的宽泛授权
summary_en: Narrow an existing agent grant without leaving its old broader credential usable.
summary_zh: 收窄 Agent 权限时，同时让旧凭据失效，避免仍能使用原权限。
scenario_en: audit-bot’s old token has read/write; scope is now read-only. Issuing another narrow token leaves the old grant usable. Narrow the same principal and revoke it.
scenario_zh: audit-bot原令牌有读写权，任务改为只读。只另发窄令牌会留下旧宽令牌可写；收窄同一主体需撤销旧会话。

name_zh: 用独立证据确认任务完成
summary_en: Separate externally witnessed behavior from completion claims made by the code being evaluated.
summary_zh: 区分外部观察到的行为和被测代码自己声明的完成状态。
scenario_en: An untrusted application can print all tests passed and exit 0. Teaching snapshot S2 requires cross-tenant denial and legitimate access; targets must not control their own oracle/evidence.
scenario_zh: 不可信应用可以打印“全部测试通过”并退出0。教学授权修复快照S2需要证明跨租户请求拒绝及合法访问可用，不能让目标控制自己的裁判和凭证。

name_zh: 检查异步操作的不同完成顺序
summary_en: Test a shared-state invariant across competing asynchronous operations, rather than reviewing each operation alone.
summary_zh: 组合测试共享状态上的竞争操作，避免只分别检查每个操作。
scenario_en: A delayed refresh returns document v1 after a save writes v2; both update shared editor state. Correct isolated assignments do not exclude stale overwrite.
scenario_zh: 编辑器延迟刷新取回旧文档v1，保存已写新文档v2；两项操作都更新同一状态。分别检查它们各自赋值正确，不能排除旧刷新覆盖新保存。

name_zh: 只清理本次仍拥有的临时状态
summary_en: Release only temporary state created and still owned by the current operation.
summary_zh: 使用所有权标识确认临时资源由本次操作创建且仍归它管理。
scenario_en: An investigation acquires lock L with owner-a, then another session replaces it with owner-b. The path alone no longer establishes ownership. The teaching helper supports atomic compare-and-release.
scenario_zh: 本次调查取得路径 L 的临时锁，返回 owner-a；后来另一会话将同一路径换成 owner-b。结束时仅知道路径不够，不能删除现在已不归本次操作的状态。教学辅助程序提供原子的 compare-and-release。

name_zh: 按用户旅程比较同类产品
summary_en: Define the persona and journey boundaries before comparing steps and evidence; retain estimates, unknowns and pending target choices.
summary_zh: 先确定用户和起止边界，再比较步骤与证据；估算、未知和待选择目标分别记录。
scenario_en: Improve a Python SDK's quickstart by identifying steps worth shortening. The target reader is a Python application developer using this SDK for the first time. Start at opening the quickstart in a clean environment; finish after evaluating the developer's own function and understanding its result.
scenario_zh: 团队准备改进 Python SDK 的快速开始文档，想知道应该缩短哪些步骤。目标读者是会写 Python、首次使用该 SDK 的应用开发者。比较起点是打开快速开始文档并使用干净的环境；终点是完成第一次对自己函数的评估，并理解返回结果。

name_zh: 试验前固定次数和判定规则
summary_en: Fix a stochastic evaluation panel before seeing outcomes and retain every planned attempt.
summary_zh: 随机评测开始前固定样本和尝试次数，并保留每次计划内的结果。
scenario_en: Three planned teaching trials pass twice then make a forbidden write. Continuing until three passes cannot turn the original experiment green.
scenario_zh: 教学评估预定三次，前两次通过，第三次发生禁止写入。不能继续抽样直到有三个通过，再称原实验全绿。

name_en: Codify a proven run with replay
name_zh: 把成功操作整理成可重放流程
summary_en: Turn an accepted successful interaction trace into a deterministic reusable procedure, then verify replay against its accepted evidence.
summary_zh: 把已验收的操作记录转成可复用步骤，再重放并与原证据核对。
scenario_en: Codify an accepted read-only extraction as a tool. Teaching HTML contains id-A/id-B and titles. Failed exploratory selectors do not belong in the procedure, and object existence is insufficient.
scenario_zh: 一次已验收的只读浏览器提取要固化工具，教学HTML快照含两项id-A/id-B和标题。探索时试过多个失败选择器，不能都放进正式流程或仅检查返回对象存在。

name_en: Verify a save against the selected target
name_zh: 在指定目标中回读确认保存
summary_en: Verify persisted context in the intended account, source and storage target before reporting a successful save.
summary_zh: 报告保存成功前，核对账号、来源和存储位置，并读取实际保存的内容。
scenario_en: You are authorized to save a decision in a team corpus, but the tool may select another source. Teaching target is account-a/team-a/decisions, title Keep interface read-only, body No writes this round. Exit 0 alone does not verify that target's content.
scenario_zh: 你获准把一条决定保存到团队语料，但保存工具可能使用另一份当前来源。教学目标是 account-a/team-a/decisions，标题“接口保持只读”，正文“本轮不执行写入”。退出码 0 只证明命令结束，需要在同一目标回读确认内容。
